Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) blueprint — week0 kickoff & GDoc seed

Hi Emma,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — thanks for sharing Beacon Health's 30/60 priorities. As discussed, I wanted to get a MAP seed into your hands so your team can review and add stakeholders.

What's included:
- A compact MAP template (GDoc) that outlines outcomes, acceptance criteria, owners, and a 6-week close timeline.
- A short week0 checklist (PDF) for environment/access needs so we can run a scoped pilot.

Please find the editable MAP here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bRedwoodMAPSeed (view/comment by default).
I've attached a one-page week0 checklist for your infra and security folks.

Proposed next steps:
1) You and your PMO add the internal owners to the GDoc by EOD Thu (6/10).
2) We'll populate technical acceptance criteria — looping in Marissa for infra and Dylan for trial metrics.
3) Quick sync Fri 6/11 11:00-11:30 PT to finalize week0 tasks and confirm demo cadence.

If any of those times don't work, send a couple alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Emma — helpful comments. Looping in Marissa and Dylan to scope the P0/P1 metrics and required artifacts.

Marissa — can you take a look at the "Security & Logging" section in the MAP (top of doc) and paste in the minimal evidence set we typically provide for a 2-week pilot? Suggested items: SOC2 attestation pointer, short network diagram, sample audit logs, API usage log snippet. Anything else you'd add?

Dylan — for trial metrics, would you propose a simple template we can drop into the MAP for throughput/latency and quality checks (e.g., token-level cost, median p50/p95 latency with 16-token prefix)? Emma is demoing a clinician triage flow, so we should tailor the metrics to end-to-end UI response time as well.

Vanessa

On attachments: I attached the week0 checklist again for quick reference.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) blueprint — week0 kickoff & GDoc seed

Hi all — quick read and here's what I'll drop into the MAP Security & Logging section:

Minimal evidence set for a 2-week pilot (deliverables):
- SOC2 summary + link to customer-facing compliance page (redwood.ai/compliance).
- Short network diagram (VPC/subnets) and a one-line note on egress controls.
- Sample audit log (redacted) showing API keys, request timestamps, and IPs.
- Access roster for trial engineers and their roles.
- Retention policy summary (how long logs/instances persist during pilot).

I'll attach a redacted log snippet and network diagram into the GDoc as a comment so Beacon's security can validate. On the latency/metrics side: we recommend p50/p95 for inference and end-to-end UI time, plus a simple correctness checklist tied to your acceptance cases.

I can be on the Fri 6/11 call; if you want, I'll lead the security walkthrough for 10 minutes.

—Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
